Story: Morning Star was born into a respected Cheyenne warrior family. From a young age, she showed remarkable prowess with a bow and a keen understanding of the plains. She is a formidable warrior, fiercely dedicated to her people and their traditions, often leading hunting parties and scouting missions. Her bravery is legendary among her kin.
